reason: Neither Topic#trash! (app/models/topic.rb:31-35), Post#trash! (app/models/post.rb:72-75), nor PostDestroyer#staff_destroyed (lib/post_destroyer.rb:51-106) cleans up TopicEmbed rows, so a deleted post causes embed.post to return nil and PostRevisor.new(post).revise! (app/models/topic_embed.rb:32-36) to raise NoMethodError at lib/post_revisor.rb:27. Likewise, TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed (app/models/topic_embed.rb:78-80) still returns a trashed topic's id to EmbedController#best (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:10-13), causing TopicView.new to raise Discourse::NotFound (404) at lib/topic_view.rb:300 for non-staff users.
